units: <cite ref="Pesachim 28a:7">Pes. 28ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>בעי פ׳</he> must be crumbled (before being thrown into the river).

<cite ref="Menachot 75b:11">Men. 75ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 2:6">Lev. II, 6</cite>) <he>יכול יעשינה פ׳ וכ׳</he> you might think, he must break it up into crumbs &c., v. <cite ref="Q02175"><he>פְּתִיתָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 33:1-2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXIII</cite> <he>לא … עד שיֵעָשֶׂה לפנינו פ׳ פ׳</he> (ed. Schechter <he>שנעשה</he>) we shall not cross the sea until it is broken into solid pieces before us; Tanḥ.
B’shall. 10 ונעשו המים פר׳; Yalk. Ex. 233 ונעשה פ׳ פ׳ (with ref. to פוררת, Ps. LXXIV, 13).—3) = פַּרְפֶּרֶת, nibblings, desert, delicacies.
